name: Bettermoo(d) Food Corporation
summary: Bettermoo(d) Food Corporation is a Canadian beverage firm dedicated to crafting and distributing drink products through both online and physical retail channels. Among its key offerings is Moodrink, a plant-derived beverage that serves as an alternative to traditional dairy. While its operational focus is in Canada, the company's corporate headquarters are located in Orlando, Florida. This entity adopted its current name in May 2022, having previously operated as Happy Gut Brands Limited.
